# Data Science for Linguists — LLM entrypoint

> Prefer markdown under `llm_corpus/` over PDFs.

## Start here

| Need | Path |
|------|------|
| Project agent rules | `AGENTS.md` |
| Course agent rules | `COURSE_AGENTS.md` |
| Lecture + assignment corpus | `llm_corpus/INDEX.md` |
| Syllabus / project rules | `llm_corpus/COURSE_MAP.md` |
| Heading router | `llm_corpus/TOPIC_INDEX.md` |
| Graded project plan | `PLAN.md` |

## Rules

1. Open only the files needed for the current question.
2. Cite `source_pdf` + `<!-- page:N -->`.
3. Solutions only on request.
4. Project framing: linguistic **loci** of annotation disagreement — not a model bake-off.
5. SpaCy tokenizes; LLM must not re-tokenize.
